mainEntity.name: How fast do TIGON Wild golf carts go?

acceptedAnswer.text: TIGON Wild golf carts can reach speeds of 25+ MPH, powered by high-torque electric motors with lithium-ion battery packs.

mainEntity.name: Are TIGON Wild golf carts street legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Street-Legal Series comes with DOT-approved headlights, turn signals, side mirrors, automotive-grade seatbelts, a windshield, and a VIN plate. They are registered and road-ready for use on roads with speed limits up to 35 mph.

mainEntity.name: What terrain can TIGON Wild carts handle?

acceptedAnswer.text: TIGON Wild carts are designed for all terrain types: forest trails, mud, mountains, sand dunes, rocky terrain, creek crossings, wet grass, steep hills, loose gravel, and paved roads (street-legal models).

mainEntity.name: What is AWD on a golf cart?

acceptedAnswer.text: AWD (All-Wheel Drive) means power is delivered to all four wheels simultaneously, providing maximum traction and grip on challenging surfaces like sand, mud, wet grass, steep hills, and loose gravel.

mainEntity.name: How do I contact TIGON Wild?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reach TIGON Wild by phone at 1-844-844-6638, by email at contact@tigongolfcarts.com, or visit tigonwild.com or tigongolfcarts.com.
